scope_note: Covers which interpretation regime supplies the meaning of "month" for the Climate Change (Scotland) Act 2009, and what that meaning is. Limited to legislation; the operation of any particular time limit in the 2009 Act is out of scope.

steps.title: Check whether the 2009 Act defines the term itself
steps.detail: Retrieve the interpretation section of the Climate Change (Scotland) Act 2009 and establish whether it defines "month" or any period of time.

steps.title: Establish which general interpretation regime applies
steps.detail: Retrieve the application provision of the Interpretation and Legislative Reform (Scotland) Act 2010 and determine, from the date the 2009 Act received Royal Assent, whether that Act's Part 1 applies to it.

steps.title: Retrieve the definition from the applicable regime
steps.detail: Retrieve the general definitions in the Scotland Act 1998 interpretation order and identify the meaning it gives to "month".

steps.title: Test the effect of later amendment
steps.detail: Establish whether a provision inserted into the 2009 Act by a later Act changes which interpretation regime governs the 2009 Act.
